The Router flagged 'structural collapse' on the background limb (severity 3). Looking closely at the image, the rear right foot is indeed indistinct and appears to melt into the sand without clear digit separation, unlike the sharp foreground foot. This is a genuine grounding artifact, not just blur. The shell texture anomaly (severity 2) is also valid; the white speckles look like noise rather than natural debris. Comparing to Reference 2 (authenticity=3.0), this image has similar or slightly better foreground clarity but comparable background weakness. Reference 3 (authenticity=4.0) is significantly sharper. A score of 3.25 feels appropriate—better than the mid-reference due to strong foreground detail, but not reaching the high-reference due to the limb melting and texture noise.
